description: Canonical field registry for post records (SPEC.md §4a, ADR-054): a signal type — something a pipeline finds and traverses from, never delivers to. Keyed on the platform-public URL and nothing else: a post without a URL is not a post the ledger can hold, so a signal declares no hash tier. Seeded with the first traverse binding; grows by demand under the rule of two.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The post's platform-public URL — the one key tier (SPEC.md §4, the url rule: scheme and host lowercased, fragment and trailing slash dropped, path and query kept).

fields.name: platform
fields.description: The platform the post lives on, lowercased. No locked value domain yet (rule of two).

fields.name: text
fields.description: The post's body text, as published.

fields.name: published_at
fields.description: When the post was published, RFC3339.
